slide_kinds.summary: A photo or screenshot beside the words about it — the case study or customer story slide. Needs a body or at least one bullet; without a picture it draws a labelled placeholder. Up to 5 bullets and 3 result metrics; past its text budgets it degrades to a content slide. For spoken testimony use the quote kind.

item_schema.description: A photo or screenshot beside the words about it — the case study or customer story slide. Needs a body or at least one bullet; without a picture it draws a labelled placeholder. Up to 5 bullets and 3 result metrics; past its text budgets it degrades to a content slide. For spoken testimony use the quote kind.

body.description: Required payload field. The story itself. ≤300 chars; give this or at least one bullet.

bullets.description: Accepted alias for the required "body" field. Up to 5 supporting points, ≤140 chars each.

caption.description: Typical (optional) payload field. Italic line under the picture. ≤120 chars.

eyebrow.description: Typical (optional) payload field. Small kicker above the heading (e.g. "Case study"). ≤30 chars.

heading.description: Typical (optional) payload field. The story's headline. ≤80 chars.

image.description: Typical (optional) payload field. The picture: a path or url string, or {path|url, alt}. Omit it to draw a labelled placeholder.

image_label.description: Typical (optional) payload field. Label for the placeholder when no picture is given. ≤40 chars.

image_side.description: Typical (optional) payload field. Which side the picture sits on: "left" (default) or "right".

layout.description: Optional composition override: one of this kind's alternative layouts (list_slide_kinds → compositions[], or explain_deck_spec slides[].alternatives). Anything else is ignored and reported as SEMANTIC_PATTERN_NOT_AVAILABLE.

metrics.description: Typical (optional) payload field. Up to 3 result figures: {value (≤10 chars), label (≤40)}. Both are required — a figure with no words is half a claim.

notes.description: Speaker notes for this slide (rendered into the PPTX notes slide, never shown on the slide).

slide_kinds.summary: The closer a consulting deck ends on: 2–6 actions, each with an owner and a date, and 0–3 decisions requested. Renders as the next-steps pattern — numbered action rows separated by rules over a 'Decisions requested' band; outside those bounds it degrades to bullets. Prefer it to a plain closing ('Thank you').

item_schema.description: The closer a consulting deck ends on: 2–6 actions, each with an owner and a date, and 0–3 decisions requested. Renders as the next-steps pattern — numbered action rows separated by rules over a 'Decisions requested' band; outside those bounds it degrades to bullets. Prefer it to a plain closing ('Thank you').

actions.description: Required payload field. 2–6 actions in order: strings or {action (≤90 chars), owner? (≤30), date? (≤20)}. Owner and date columns drop when no action has one.

decisions.description: Typical (optional) payload field. 0–3 decisions requested (≤120 chars each), rendered in a band with a left accent rule under the actions.

decisions_label.description: Typical (optional) payload field. Band label (default "Decisions requested").

source.description: Source / footnote line shown under the slide content.

slide_kinds.summary: Options scored against shared criteria — the evaluation matrix a recommendation is argued on. 2–6 criteria × 2–6 options render as the table-highlight pattern with the recommended row and decisive column highlighted; outside that it degrades to a scored bullet list.

corner_label.description: Label for the table's empty top-left corner cell.

criteria.description: Required payload field. 2–6 evaluation criteria (table columns): a string label, or {label, scale?} to override the scale for that column.

decisive_criterion.description: Typical (optional) payload field. The criterion that decides it, named (matched against criteria[].label) or as a column index — its column is highlighted.

highlight_label.description: Typical (optional) payload field. Badge on the highlighted row (e.g. "Recommended").

options.description: Required payload field. 2–6 options (table rows): {name, detail?, scores[]} with one score per criterion. detail/description/summary ≤80 chars for up to 4 options × 4 criteria, ≤60 in denser matrices.

description.description: Descriptor under the option name: ≤80 chars in a matrix up to 4×4; ≤60 in a denser matrix.

detail.description: Descriptor under the option name: ≤80 chars in a matrix up to 4×4; ≤60 in a denser matrix.

summary.description: Descriptor under the option name: ≤80 chars in a matrix up to 4×4; ≤60 in a denser matrix.

pattern.description: Optional composition override: one of this kind's alternative patterns (list_slide_kinds → compositions[], or explain_deck_spec slides[].alternatives). Anything else is ignored and reported as SEMANTIC_PATTERN_NOT_AVAILABLE.

recommended.description: Typical (optional) payload field. The recommended option, named (matched against options[].name) or as a row index — its row is highlighted.

scale.description: Typical (optional) payload field. Score vocabulary: harvey (0–4 or none/quarter/half/three-quarter/full, the default), rag (red/amber/green), or text (≤24 chars). Use "-" for n/a.

slide_kinds.summary: One slide, one title, 2–3 typed regions: the chart on the left with the KPI and the timeline stacked on the right. arrangement is columns or rows (2–3 regions; size_pct is each one's width / height) or main_left / main_right / main_top / main_bottom (exactly 3: regions[0] is the main region and its size_pct its share, default 60; regions[1..2] stack beside it and split that side by their own size_pct). Each region is {kind, size_pct?, heading?, source?, …} with kind chart (chart, unit), stat (value, label, unit, context), kpis (2–4 kpis), table (headers, rows; ≤4 columns × 5 rows), timeline (3–7 milestones), image (image, caption) or text (body, bullets) — the fields of the like-named slide kind. Region sources join the slide's source line. Use it only when the content types must be read together; one kind per slide stays the default.

item_schema.description: One slide, one title, 2–3 typed regions: the chart on the left with the KPI and the timeline stacked on the right. arrangement is columns or rows (2–3 regions; size_pct is each one's width / height) or main_left / main_right / main_top / main_bottom (exactly 3: regions[0] is the main region and its size_pct its share, default 60; regions[1..2] stack beside it and split that side by their own size_pct). Each region is {kind, size_pct?, heading?, source?, …} with kind chart (chart, unit), stat (value, label, unit, context), kpis (2–4 kpis), table (headers, rows; ≤4 columns × 5 rows), timeline (3–7 milestones), image (image, caption) or text (body, bullets) — the fields of the like-named slide kind. Region sources join the slide's source line. Use it only when the content types must be read together; one kind per slide stays the default.

arrangement.description: Typical (optional) payload field. columns (default) or rows: 2–3 regions, size_pct is each one's width / height. main_left / main_right / main_top / main_bottom: exactly 3 regions, regions[0] is the main one (size_pct = its share, default 60) and regions[1..2] stack beside it, splitting that side by their own size_pct.

column_alignments.description: Typical (optional) payload field. Per-column alignment: left / center / right (the engine's l / ctr / r are accepted too). Right-align numeric columns.

column_types.description: Per-column type hint for the renderer's number formatting, e.g. text / number / currency / percent.

headers.description: Required payload field. Column headers (up to 6). The table's first row.

highlight_column.description: Typical (optional) payload field. The column to emphasise, named (matched against a header) or as a 0-based index.

rows.description: Required payload field. Data rows (up to 6, so the table stays within the 7-row budget including the header). A row is a list of cell values, or an object keyed by header label. Short rows render blank cells.

takeaway.description: Typical (optional) payload field. One-line takeaway footer.

totals_row.description: Typical (optional) payload field. Set true when the last data row is a totals row, so the renderer emphasises it.
